# watchpoint_sso_configuration (Data Source)

Looks up a single SSO configuration by its connection name within the tenant. Only non-sensitive metadata is exposed; the client secret and SAML certificate / private key are never returned.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "watchpoint_sso_configuration" "example" {
  name = "Corporate Entra ID"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Connection name of the SSO configuration to look up (case-insensitive).

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) SSO configuration ID.
- `is_enabled` (Boolean) Whether the connection is enabled.
- `provider_type` (String) SSO provider type (e.g. `EntraId`, `Okta`, `OidcGeneric`).
